items.q: You know, Columbus never touched the mainland, you must understand.

ctx.x: After all, "Negro" was merely the Spanish word for "Black."

That's another thing, too. When people protest about that word, "Negro" -- if you're going to say it in Spanish, it's the same thing. What people don't realize, especially the American Negroes (if you want to call them Negroes)...Blacks... They were processed in the Caribbean. I mean, that was the beginning of the New World.
